correctness.rationale: The 90 multiset permutations of 001122 give a finite compatibility graph with 2745 undirected edges for minimum Hamming distance >=4. A fresh bit-mask Bron-Kerbosch maximal-clique implementation fully enumerated 90,627 maximal cliques, with counts by sizes 6:38895, 7:20160, 8:20520, 9:10320, 11:720, 15:12. Thus maximum size is 15 and precisely twelve labeled maxima exist. Every maximum meets the Hamming distance condition; source orbit calculation gives one S6 x S3 orbit (order4320, stabilizer360), a balanced five-of-each-symbol coordinate distribution and distance-pair counts 90 at4 and 15 at6. Finite enumeration exhausts every feasible code, not just a heuristic optimizer.
